pastEvents.name: Summer of CodeFest 2.0
pastEvents.description: Summer of CodeFest 2.0 featured an intensive 24-hour innovation hackathon paired with masterclasses on navigating Google Summer of Code organizations, writing winning proposals, and building scalable open-source projects.
highlights: Specialized workshop on GSoC proposal writing
Evaluation by faculty coordinators & senior engineers

pastEvents.name: Campus Unleashed
pastEvents.description: Campus Unleashed kicked off the academic year with an energetic introduction to open-source culture, club roadmap, live coding demonstrations, interactive technical games, and hands-on guidance on making first open source pull requests.
highlights: Q&A panel with successful GSoC alumni
Launch of the GSoC Innovators Club contributor initiatives

pastEvents.name: CinemaGhar
pastEvents.description: A community bonding and celebration event where club members and tech enthusiasts gathered for an interactive movie screening of Chhichhore, peer networking, fun quizzes, and team engagement.
highlights: Interactive tech quizzes and engagement games
Peer networking across batches and domains
Housefull turnout with vibrant community spirit

pastEvents.name: Summer Of CodeFest
pastEvents.description: The inaugural edition that started it all — Summer Of CodeFest brought the open-source spirit to the university, giving students their first structured hackathon experience oriented around real open-source repos.
highlights: Inaugural hackathon of GSoC Innovators Club
Introductory guidance on Git branching & PR workflows
Laying the foundation for our 100+ member community
